content.text: The sniff tool against "mock-gym" only returns a trivial echo of the scent (`"posting:mock-gym"`) rather than any real posting data. There's no real board adapter here — this is the no-op/no-spend stub, not an actual job source. Since there's no genuine territory to investigate (no real listings, companies, or postings data to evaluate), there's nothing to capture as a worthwhile catch.
